##### Project general facts

Starline Beach Residences embodies an exquisite beachfront lifestyle, located on the picturesque Sobha Siniya Island. This exclusive development consists of four elegant towers offering 1-2 bedroom apartments and 3 bedroom duplexes with breathtaking views of the Arabian Sea. The project seamlessly blends modern comfort with natural beauty, creating an atmosphere of absolute serenity and luxury.

The residences are surrounded by a wealth of amenities, from pristine sandy beaches and turquoise lagoons to lush gardens and scenic parks. The development features world-class facilities, including swimming pools, fitness centers, children’s play areas, and dedicated relaxation and socializing spaces. For those who enjoy an active lifestyle, the community offers water sports, beachfront yoga, and picturesque walking trails.

Starline Beach Residences is designed to provide an unparalleled living experience, where contemporary architecture meets thoughtful design. Expansive balconies, floor-to-ceiling windows, and high-end finishes ensure an atmosphere of sophistication and tranquility. Every aspect of the development is carefully curated to offer residents a perfect balance of luxury, privacy, and connection to nature.

##### Location description and benefits

Siniyah Island, located in Umm Al Quwain, is a serene and picturesque destination renowned for its natural beauty and tranquil environment. This island offers a pristine escape from the hustle and bustle of city life, characterized by its lush landscapes, sparkling waters, and abundant wildlife. Its unspoiled beaches and gentle coastal breezes make it a perfect retreat for those seeking relaxation and a connection with nature.

The island's strategic location provides easy access to major urban centers while maintaining a sense of seclusion. With its proximity to Dubai and Sharjah, Siniyah Island combines the benefits of a peaceful, secluded environment with the convenience of urban amenities. This makes it an ideal spot for both residents and visitors who wish to enjoy a balance of tranquility and accessibility.

Siniyah Island is also known for its commitment to sustainable development and environmental preservation. The island features eco-friendly infrastructure and carefully planned urban spaces that respect the natural landscape. This dedication to sustainability ensures that Siniyah Island remains a beautiful and welcoming destination for years to come.
